Maria (PM): Ok team — I'm starting a PRD draft for the structured output + tool-calling launch. Need to align on customer-driven asks, acceptance criteria, and launch gates. Major areas: schema validation modes, fallback semantics, tool auth/permissions, streaming validation, and observability for failures.

Sam (Eng): Can you paste the rough launch criteria here? I'll run it against perf and rollout constraints.

Maria (PM): Rough acceptance criteria (initial):
```yaml
acceptance_criteria:
  - schema_validation_success_rate: '>=95% for strict-mode on eval datasets'
  - fallback_behavior: 'structured_error with code + human_message when tool call fails'
  - security: 'no P0 gaps for KMS/HSM integrations'
  - perf: 'p50 latency increase <= 10% over baseline'
  - observability: 'traces + per-route failure metrics live in console'
```

Devon (ML infra): Question: do we enforce strict schema by default or make it opt-in? Some open models output noisy/partial JSON.

Maria (PM): Decision proposal: default = best-effort (lenient) validation; strict validation is opt-in per route/customer. PRD should define validation levels (lenient, strict, streaming-aware) and exact error codes.

Alex (Solutions): From customer triage: fintech pilot requires strict + audit logs; marketplace search wants fuzzy fallback that preserves tokens. We need to support both with clear tradeoffs in PRD.

Sam (Eng): Implementation notes: strict mode will require sync validation before returning — expect ~50-200ms overhead depending on payload and model. Propose rollout: canary strict-mode on Dedicated, then expand.

Ryan (DevEx): SDK + docs: expose validateSchema(route, mode) and migration guide. Also add examples for streaming validation. We should ship SDK hooks with the first canary.

Maria (PM): Proposed launch gates: security sign-off, >80% E2E test coverage for schema paths, perf within SLO, docs + migration guide, and 2 customer pilots (one strict fintech, one fuzzy PLG).

Devon (ML infra): Edge cases we must call out in PRD: partial schema satisfaction (partial fields present), streaming outputs (validators receive tokens incrementally), parallel tool calls (vectorized tool idempotency), and model hallucinated tool calls. Need explicit acceptance behavior per edge case.

Sam (Eng): For streaming: propose validator streams incremental feedback and final validation marker. For partial schemas we return structured response with fields present + validation.errors array. Error codes: ERROR_SCHEMA_MISMATCH, ERROR_TOOL_AUTH, ERROR_TOOL_TIMEOUT, ERROR_STREAM_INCOMPLETE.

Maria (PM): Good. We also need a fallback UX spec: when strict-mode fails in production, route-level policy = {reject | fallback_to_model | return_partial_with_warnings}. Default = return_partial_with_warnings for PLG routes, reject for regulated routes.

Alex (Solutions): Pilot plan: I'll coordinate fintech contact for strict test and marketplace for fuzzy behavior. Need a short runbook for each pilot (what data, success criteria, rollback).

Sam (Eng): Actionable engineering tasks:
- prototype validator lib + perf numbers (Sam)
- streaming validation design doc (Devon + Sam)
- route policy config + API surface (Sam + Ryan)
- SDK changes + examples (Ryan)
- PRD draft with acceptance criteria and pilot plans (Maria)

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled for staging on 2026-04-05 03:00 UTC :rocket:

Maria (PM): Action items recap: @Sam prototype + perf by next Wed, @Ryan draft SDK API and migration guide, @Alex set up pilot customers, @Devon help define streaming constraints. I'll assemble PRD and share RFC for review by Friday. :thumbsup:

Sam (Eng): Ack. I'll add an initial perf table to the RFC so product can see the latency/cost tradeoffs.

Ryan (DevEx): I'll stub SDK PR and include code examples for strict vs lenient routes.

Devon (ML infra): I'll write up streaming validation flow and examples for partial emits. Also will add test harness for vectorized tool calls.

Maria (PM): Thanks — leaving notes in PRD draft. Next sync: quick check-in Tues morning if we have prototypes.

Alex (Solutions): +1. I'll follow up with pilot timelines and success metrics.

Sam (Eng): :thumbsup:
